title: Customer Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 The Domain Architect is responsible for defining and implementing the Core domain\-wide strategy for Application(Cloud network function) deployment automation and AI\-enabled Automation SW development and delivery across various Nokia blueprint as well as customized product teams. The role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Network function deployment automation frameworks, CI/CD ecosystems, and the application of AI capabilities to optimize development workstreams, operational efficiency and delivery velocity. The architect will drive scalable, maintainable automation solutions, enable self\-healing delivery pipelines, and mentor teams in modern DevOps and AI\-assisted SW engineering practices.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead requirement analysis, solution alignment, and end\-to\-end architecture activities, including HLD, LLD, CIQ validation and solution governance.
* Define migration strategies, provide technical leadership, and guide implementation activities across the complete migration lifecycle.
* Drive customization discussions, RCA execution, escalation management, and resolution of technical issues in collaboration with Care, R\&D and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and delivery readiness activities to ensure successful solution deployment and adoption.
* Promote innovation through automation, AI\-driven solutions, next\-generation delivery practices, and close collaboration with R\&D/Development team on product enhancements.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with 10\+ years of experience in architecting software, IT, or telecom solutions.
* Exhibit extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containerized application deployments.
* Proven experience in defining Cloud\-native architectures and delivering those solutions to the market.
* Experience working effectively in global organizations, with strong communication, motivational and technical leadership skills.
* Prior design and application deployment experience in custom solution and applications products.


 Nice\-to\-Have:
   

  

* Telecom domain exposure (Packet Core, 4G/5G, network protocols, cloud\-native network functions) and Experience in implementing autonomous deployment platforms or AI\-driven operational automation.
* Knowledge of MLOps, AI platform operations and deployment of AI/ML workloads in cloud\-native environments and Certifications in cloud platforms or AI/ML specialties


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Warehouse handler
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Warehouse Handler, you will ensure smooth operations for new supplier parts receipt, production hold parts, and inventory accuracy.
   

  

 You will work with the warehouse team and report to the Warehouse Team Lead and work onsite in Kancheepuram, India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Manage new supplier parts receipt and tracking in SAP and WMS systems.
* Segregate MRB parts and scrap materials from production and suppliers as per quality guidelines.
* Maintain accurate MRB and scrap inventory records in SAP and WMS systems.
* Perform inventory cycle counts for MRB and scrap stock and execute SAP adjustments on time.
* Post scrap transactions in SAP and ensure compliance with disposal processes.
* Coordinate scrap disposal with approved vendors, ensuring proper documentation (Gate Pass, Disposal Certificate).
* Prepare and maintain scrap and MRB reports using MS Excel and share with Quality and EHS teams.
* Coordinate with receiving an kitting team also will do the supporting role of these functions.
* Ensure safety and environmental compliance during scrap handling and disposal.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* Diploma / Degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum of 3 years experience in similar field
* Strong knowledge of warehouse management applications and Microsoft Office suite.
* Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS) and proficiency in using relevant software applications.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, and Outlook).
* Ability to operate warehouse equipment, such as forklifts or pallet jacks, and obtain necessary certifications if required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as required by operational needs.


**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
* 3\+ years of experience in automotive warehouse
* Hands\-on experience in SAP transactions (GRN, TO, cycle count, scrap posting).
* Familiarity with Lean practices and inventory accuracy improvement projects.


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

title: Client Servicing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 BCC Martech is a fully integrated brand management agency that specializes in end\-to\-end planning, designing, and execution of brand communication. The agency delivers consistent brand messaging across print, TV, outdoor, digital, and techno\-creative media. BCC Martech combines strategic thinking with creative solutions to help clients strengthen their brand presence. Team members collaborate across disciplines to support diverse campaigns and long\-term brand initiatives.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Client Servicing Executive role based in Poonamallee. The Client Servicing Executive will manage day\-to\-day client interactions, understand client requirements, and coordinate with internal creative, marketing, and production teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of campaigns. Responsibilities include preparing and delivering presentations, tracking project progress, resolving client queries, and maintaining detailed documentation of deliverables and feedback. The role also involves supporting account growth by identifying opportunities for additional services, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, and contributing to the smooth execution of brand communication across multiple media channels.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Client Services and Client Relations skills to manage expectations and build long\-term partnerships.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Service capabilities to respond promptly, handle concerns, and ensure a positive client experience.
* Candidates should possess effective Account Management skills to oversee projects, manage timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess confident Presentations skills to prepare and present proposals, reports, and campaign updates.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in advertising, marketing, or brand management agencies.
* Candidates should have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
